name: AltRank improvement — long assets climbing LunarCrush's combined social+market rank
rationale: LunarCrush AltRank is a CROSS-SECTIONAL composite rank that blends an asset's social activity and market performance against the whole coin universe (1 = best, larger = worse). Unlike the raw social_volume LEVEL — which drifts ~160x over 2020-26 and makes any fitted level floor always-true (the phase0-social-signal §4 trap) — AltRank is a BOUNDED rank, so a threshold on it genuinely binds across the sample and a CROSS into a better band is a real, scale-stable event. The hypothesis: an asset whose AltRank is IMPROVING (the rank NUMBER falling, i.e. cross_down through a strong-band floor) is gaining relative social+market strength faster than its peers — the Barber-Odean attention-buying bias plus relative-strength continuation should carry it for a few days before the improvement is fully priced. We enter LONG (spot-only — no shorts on Binance spot) when AltRank crosses DOWN into the top band WHILE own-price momentum confirms (so we ride genuine relative strength, not a dead-cat where the rank improves only because everything else fell harder), and exit when AltRank deteriorates back up through an exit threshold (relative strength lost) or risk limits hit. Disconfirmer 1: the edge must come from the IMPROVEMENT (the cross), not the static altitude — if replacing the `cross_down` entry with a plain `lt rank_floor` level filter yields an equal-or-better deflated Sharpe, the signal is just 'currently high-ranked' (already priced), not 'climbing', and the claimed edge is false. Disconfirmer 2: AltRank co-moves mechanically with price (price IS one of its inputs), so a price-momentum control arm must NOT subsume it — if dropping AltRank entirely and keeping only ret_Nd momentum matches the deflated Sharpe, AltRank adds no orthogonal information. NOTE: DATA-BLOCKED until the LunarCrush hoard (scripts/lunarcrush_max_extract.py) lands alt_rank per coin; tier1 + low-confidence until validated OOS — the Gate down-weights until it earns its place.
catalyst: alt_rank crosses DOWN into the top band (relative social+market strength improving) while price momentum confirms
